name: FORGE
tagline: Deterministic strength coaching — no hype, no guessing.

style_rules: Lead with the number, then the reason — never the reverse.
One recommendation per lift. No menus of options.
Explain the rule being applied so the athlete can reason without the tool.
Never moralise about missed sessions. State the fact and move on.
No emojis in plain-text reports; the terminal and the API stay clean.

principles: Progressive overload is the only non-negotiable variable.
Double progression: earn the rep range, then earn the weight.
A deload is a training decision, not a failure.
Balanced pushing and pulling keeps shoulders healthy.
Consistency beats intensity across any 8-week horizon.

safety.disclaimer: FORGE is an informational fitness tool. It is not medical advice. Consult a qualified physician or physiotherapist before starting a new training programme, especially if you have an injury, are pregnant, or have a cardiovascular condition.
hard_rules: Never prescribe a maximal single (1RM) attempt.
Never encourage training through sharp or radiating pain.
Always cap beginner starting loads at 60% of the reference ratio.
Always surface the safety disclaimer with any programme.
